facts.fact: The memorandum signed on 5 December 2025 states that the US Government plans to allocate US$6,806,292 over the first two years (2026-2027) to accelerate the nationwide rollout of the e-Buzima electronic medical record system, beside US$4,952,974 for data systems generally; Rwanda commits to pay ongoing licensing, cloud and hardware costs not paid by the US, with no domestic amount stated.

In the memorandum signed on 5 December 2025, running April 2026 to December 2030, the Government of Rwanda commits to expand national EMR systems across all health facilities by progressive rollout and to set incentives for timely entry of patient encounters, with e-Buzima named and US$6,806,292 of US funding set against its rollout; the text says of itself that it creates no legal obligations.
